prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023 to call for the entire records connected with the impugned FIR in Crime No. 370 of 2019 dated 27-7-2019 on the file of the first respondent and quash the same
judgment_text:
ORDER

The petitioner seeks for quash of the FIR in Crime No. 370 of 2019 dated 27-7-2019 on the file of the first respondent.

2. When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned government advocate appearing for the respondent police submitted that the investigation had already been completed and the case had been closed as “undetected” and RCS notice has also been served on the petitioner.

3. Recording the aforesaid submissions made, this criminal original petition is closed. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
